# Children's Health Defense

> Children's Health Defense is a health advocacy organization focused on vaccine safety, medical freedom, and informed consent through investigative journalism and multimedia content.

CHD provides educational resources and advocacy content centered on vaccine safety, health policy, and medical autonomy. The organization operates CHD-TV, a video platform featuring expert discussions, documentary series, and archived shows examining health policy, WHO governance, and vaccine-related topics.

## Key Topics

- Vaccine Safety
- Medical Freedom
- Informed Consent
- Health Advocacy
- Vaccine Injury
- Health Policy
- WHO Criticism
- Global Governance
- Pandemic Preparedness
- Biosecurity
- PANDAS/PANS
- Havana Syndrome
- Documentary Series
- ACIP
- Medical Organizations

## CHD-TV Video Platform

- [CHD-TV](https://live.childrenshealthdefense.org/chd-tv): CHD-TV video platform for health advocacy and vaccine safety content featuring expert discussions and educational programming.

## Optional Resources

- [Archived Shows](https://live.childrenshealthdefense.org/chd-tv/archive): Archive of past CHD-TV episodes on health policy and WHO criticism.
